name: Vingilot
summary: Fast, distraction-free GTK4 and Libadwaita web browser with native Wayland acceleration
description: Privacy-first, native Linux web browser built in Rust with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Features hardware-accelerated Wayland rendering, Círdan offline encrypted password vault, built-in tracker shield, standalone download daemon, and local/cloud AI side panel.

name: Vingilot Estel
summary: Next-generation experimental GTK4 & Libadwaita web browser powered by Mozilla Servo & WebKit.
description: Vingilot Estel explores next-generation parallel web rendering by combining a native GTK4 & Libadwaita shell with Mozilla Servo and WebKit hybrid engine backends.

name: Mithrandir
summary: Linux system maintenance suite, cleaner, optimizer, and AI diagnostic assistant
description: Modern Linux cleaner and maintenance companion built with Python, GTK4, and Libadwaita. Combines deep cache and package cleaning with hardware telemetry, systemd service management, and automated AI diagnostic troubleshooting.

name: Mithrandir-RS (Rust)
summary: Blazing-fast Linux system cleaner, real-time hardware telemetry, and AI diagnostics in Rust
description: High-performance Linux system cleaner and diagnostic companion rewritten in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. Delivers zero-sleep real-time CPU/GPU metrics, multi-threaded cache cleaning, debounced Smart Boost, ClamAV quarantine vault, and local/cloud AI diagnostics.

name: Imladris
summary: WPS-style scientific polyglot studio and Markdown editor with live WebKitGTK preview
description: Native Linux scientific polyglot studio and document editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Features an adaptive three-tier ribbon interface, Quarto (.qmd), R Markdown (.Rmd), and Jupyter (.ipynb) support, KaTeX math formulas, Mermaid diagrams, MCP server integration, and in-editor AI co-authoring.

name: Debian Cachy Kernel Updater
summary: Guided 1-2-3 GUI manager for installing and managing optimized CachyOS kernels on Debian
description: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita application to discover, compile, install, optimize, and cryptographically sign CachyOS Linux kernels on Debian. Features BORE scheduler tuning, automated microarchitecture selection (x86-64-v3/v4), MOK Secure Boot signing, and fallback kernel retention.

name: YouTube Comment Extractor
summary: Extract, filter, and export YouTube comments with GTK4 and multi-format reports
description: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop application to harvest, inspect, and export YouTube comments and nested reply trees. Features an embedded cookie harvester to bypass age gates and rate limits, uniform and Poisson statistical sampling, and multi-format export (CSV with emojis, structured JSON, HTML).

name: YouTube Comment Extractor Service
summary: Background extraction daemon and system tray controller for YouTube Comment Extractor
description: Background service and system tray indicator (StatusNotifierItem) providing a local REST API, WebSocket progress streamer, and localhost web dashboard for automated background YouTube comment scraping.

name: Súlimo (Arda's Breath)
summary: Local, battery-disciplined LLM inference engine with GTK4 and Libadwaita.
description: Súlimo (Arda's Breath) is a high-performance, battery-disciplined local LLM inference engine optimized for Intel Gen8–10 legacy hardware. Features asymmetric OpenCL FP16 prompt prefill, AVX2 physical-core decode with iGPU RC6 deep sleep, and a responsive Libadwaita interface.

name: Validity VFS5011 Linux Fix
summary: Automated Linux driver fix and installer for Validity VFS5011 fingerprint sensors (138a:0011, 138a:0017, 138a:0018).
description: Patches, compiles, and installs experimental Linux driver support for Validity VFS5011 fingerprint readers on modern Debian and Ubuntu distributions.
